learningStrategy.title: Python-first applied AI for remote roles
learningStrategy.summary: You bring 3+ years of enterprise software engineering in Bangladesh, .NET backend strengths, beginner Python and early RAG experience. Build Python competence, measure retrieval and model behavior, then deploy secure services and present reproducible evidence to remote employers.

steps.title: Applied ML and Python AI services
Enterprise RAG, evaluation and business tools
Senior ownership and remote career preparation
steps.detail: Prioritized pipeline and tailored role evidence

learningStrategy.rule: Complete work only after an independent implementation, relevant tests, and an evidence review. Pick a schedule based on available hours.

weeks.title: Python values and control
weeks.objective: Write a typed row validator.

tasks.text: Write a typed row validator. Test zero, empty text, missing field and whitespace independently.
Repair state leaking between two ledger imports. Independent runs produce exact deterministic totals.

steps: Syntax and control flow — Indentation, truthiness, None, branches, loops and f-strings.
Object identity and money — Names bind objects; aliasing, shallow copy, identity vs equality and Decimal.
learningGuide.practice: Write a typed row validator.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Test zero, empty text, missing field and whitespace independently. Independent runs produce exact deterministic totals.

weeks.title: Containers and functions
weeks.objective: Write a bounded recent-record buffer.

tasks.text: Write a bounded recent-record buffer. Demonstrate ordered output and bounded size.
Deduplicate ledger records by source and ID. Preserve deterministic counts and justify average lookup costs.

steps: Lists, tuples and deque — Slicing, comprehensions, ordering, append and front-removal costs.
Dictionaries and sets — Hashability, composite keys, counting and set membership.
Functions and scope — Positional and keyword args, closures, return values and LEGB scope.
learningGuide.practice: Write a bounded recent-record buffer.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Demonstrate ordered output and bounded size. Preserve deterministic counts and justify average lookup costs. Run parametrized transformations without files.

Errors and cleanup — Typed exceptions, chaining, finally, exit codes and terminal errors.
learningGuide.practice: Separate CLI, read/parse and business modules.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Imports perform no I/O and work from a clean install. Corrupt input preserves the previous output. Report actionable causes without exposing sensitive rows.

weeks.title: OOP and structural typing
weeks.objective: Model an import job.

tasks.text: Model an import job. Separate instances maintain independent state.
Reject invalid jobs at initialization. Tests cover missing and invalid fields.
Fix a shared-list error. Instances no longer share unintended mutations.
Implement an import job transition. Reject invalid transitions and preserve invariants.
Add from_row to a typed model. Subtype construction and validation work.
Compare static method and module function. Show identical behavior and justify the API location.
Expose a read-only status view. All public mutations preserve invariants.
Implement a parser subtype. Run shared contract tests.
Override a parser hook. Base guarantees still hold.
Swap native and OCR adapters. Run one suite against both.
Block incomplete DocumentReader implementations. Incomplete implementation cannot be instantiated.
Compose parser, validator and sink. Swap the sink without subclassing.
Predict and check a tiny class hierarchy. Prediction matches __mro__ and output.
Add a validated transition attribute. Invalid changes fail with useful errors.
Model an immutable document key. Check equality and independent defaults.
Check fake and real clients against one consumer interface. Checker rejects an incompatible implementation.
Inject a fake clock and swap two adapters. Tests expose no external resource dependencies and one rejected pattern is documented.

steps: Objects and classes — Identity, instance behavior and self.
Constructors and attributes — __init__, invariants and instance attributes.
Class attributes — Attribute sharing, lookup and shadowing.
Instance methods — Bound methods, self and behavior on instance state.
Class methods — cls and alternate constructors.
Static methods — Class namespace and unbound helpers.
Encapsulation — Public contract, underscore convention and mutation control.
Inheritance — Subtype contracts and inherited behavior.
Overriding — Dispatch, super and compatible behavior.
Polymorphism — Duck typing and substitutable adapters.
Abstraction and ABCs — Minimal consumer API, ABC and abstractmethod.
Composition — Delegation and replaceable dependencies.
Multiple inheritance and MRO — Mixins, diamond lookup and cooperative super.
Properties and descriptors — property, getter/setter and descriptor protocol intuition.
Dataclasses — Generated methods, default_factory, frozen and equality.
Protocols and generics — Structural typing, Protocol, TypeVar and runtime limits.
SOLID, DI and patterns — Interface segregation, explicit lifetimes, adapter, strategy and composition root.
learningGuide.practice: Model an import job.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Separate instances maintain independent state. Tests cover missing and invalid fields. Instances no longer share unintended mutations. Reject invalid transitions and preserve invariants. Subtype construction and validation work. Show identical behavior and justify the API location. All public mutations preserve invariants. Run shared contract tests. Base guarantees still hold. Run one suite against both. Incomplete implementation cannot be instantiated. Swap the sink without subclassing. Prediction matches __mro__ and output. Invalid changes fail with useful errors. Check equality and independent defaults. Checker rejects an incompatible implementation. Tests expose no external resource dependencies and one rejected pattern is documented.

pytest fixtures and test levels — Fixtures, parametrization, fake dependencies and database integration.
learningGuide.practice: Stream fixed-size batches.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Memory grows with batch size rather than input length. Failures and cancellation release resources. Tests isolate state and catch a seeded regression.

weeks.objective: Design and review an embedding cutover with a rollback exercise.

tasks.text: Design and review an embedding cutover with a rollback exercise. Demonstrate cutover consistency and document scaling limits.

steps: System design and migrations — Modular boundaries, staged migrations, dual reads, dependency isolation and cost models.
learningGuide.practice: Design and review an embedding cutover with a rollback exercise.

weeks.title: Operational ownership
weeks.deliverable: P12 SaaS release, runbook and game day
weeks.objective: Lead review, write two ADRs and run a game day.

tasks.text: Lead review, write two ADRs and run a game day. Independent review, peer adoption and follow-up decision evidence.
Mentor a peer through a delivery problem and request feedback. Peer independently applies the method and gives attributable feedback.

steps: Architecture review and standards — ADRs, quality gates, budgets, owner assignment and operational feedback.
Mentoring and communication — Teach debugging, review trade-offs and communicate scope to stakeholders.
learningGuide.practice: Lead review, write two ADRs and run a game day.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Independent review, peer adoption and follow-up decision evidence. Peer independently applies the method and gives attributable feedback.

weeks.title: Remote interview loops
weeks.deliverable: Two technical mocks and portfolio review
weeks.objective: Run timed unfamiliar coding and SQL prompts.

tasks.text: Run timed unfamiliar coding and SQL prompts. Explain edge cases, complexity and measured plan changes.
Record 90-second introduction, design review and incident story. Two independent mocks and a focused retest.

steps: Python and SQL interviews — Complexity, streaming, joins, windows, query plans and cancellation.
AI design and English communication — Evaluation, safety, SLOs, trade-offs, evidence and concise asynchronous updates.
learningGuide.practice: Run timed unfamiliar coding and SQL prompts.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Explain edge cases, complexity and measured plan changes. Two independent mocks and a focused retest.

weeks.title: Remote applications
weeks.deliverable: Prioritized pipeline and tailored role evidence
weeks.objective: Tailor two applications and record three proof links per role.

tasks.text: Tailor two applications and record three proof links per role. Each target has eligibility source, next action and evidence.
Log opportunities, mock feedback and a revision action. Review pipeline after two weeks and update target roles from evidence.

steps: Remote role analysis and portfolio — Role evidence, Bangladesh eligibility, UTC overlap, case studies and transparent claims.
Remote application feedback loop — Pipeline stages, follow-up, written communication and feedback patterns.

learningGuide.readyWhen: Each target has eligibility source, next action and evidence. Review pipeline after two weeks and update target roles from evidence.
